evidence: Official doc: all native Maya commands exposed via the maya.cmds Python module (import maya.cmds); scripts runnable from command line and Script Editor.
mayapy is Maya's bundled Python interpreter run from a command line, explicitly useful for batch processing and accessing Maya libraries outside the GUI.
maya.standalone.initialize() lets external Python interpreters load Maya libraries, check out licenses, and run maya.cmds headlessly without a Maya session.
Maya supports -batch flag (mayabatch.exe on Windows) and -prompt mode to execute commands without the UI, plus -command/-script startup flags.
pymxs module exposes the entire MAXScript runtime (pymxs.runtime) plus context expressions like animate/attime to Python scripts inside 3ds Max.
3dsmaxbatch.exe is a standalone headless executable that runs MAXScript or Python (.py/.pyc/.pyw) scripts, loads an optional scene, executes, and exits.
3dsmax.exe supports -U MAXScript/-U PythonHost launch scripts, -mxs inline command strings, and -silent flag for unattended batch rendering workflows.
Official Cinema 4D Python SDK documentation; C4D 2026.3.0 ships a CPython 3.11 interpreter with the c4d API module for scripting scenes and plugins.
c4dpy is a standalone Python interpreter that is also a headless Cinema 4D instance; can load files, build scenes, save files, and render without GUI.
hython ships with Houdini, auto-imports the hou module, accepts .hip files on the command line, and supports remote openport commands via -b flag.
Houdini Engine exposes a C API (HAPI) and Python wrapper to run Houdini's procedural core inside other DCCs or custom pipeline tools.
PDG/TOPs defines procedural dependency graphs of tasks schedulable locally, on render farms, or cloud for automated, repeatable content pipelines.
ZScript is ZBrush's built-in scripting language for automating tasks and adding functionality; ~200 square-bracket commands, plain-text .txt zscripts.
GoZ SDK is file/protocol-based rather than a true plugin API: target apps communicate with ZBrush via external utilities and GoZ data files.
Unreal Python API plus PythonScript Plugin script and automate the Unreal Editor; editor-only (not runtime) Python for pipeline automation.
UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe runs a Python script headlessly via '-run=pythonscript -script=...' commandlet invocation on a .uproject.
Remote Control API runs a web server inside UE serving HTTP endpoints (remote/object/call, property, batch) and WebSocket to drive the engine remotely.
Unity Editor supports -batchmode (no UI, no human interaction) and -executeMethod Class.Method to run static C# methods at launch for CI/automation.
Substance Automation Toolkit: command line tools (sbsbaker etc.) plus Pysbs Python API to read/create/modify .sbs and .sbsar without Designer GUI.
Official Marvelous Designer Python Script API docs covering import/export, pattern, and simulation APIs on Windows and macOS, plus .py plugin registration.
MCP server bridging LLM clients to a C++ plugin in UE 5.7 editor over TCP localhost:55557; 101 tools for actors, assets, PIE, screenshots.
MCP server for Autodesk Maya that drives the app via its built-in commandPort MEL/Python socket; no in-Maya install needed; tested Maya 2023/2025.
Houdini MCP bridge talks to hou API over TCP socket; auto-launches headless hython if no GUI running; 166 MCP tools including PDG/TOPs and Solaris.
Maya sold subscription-only: monthly, annual, and 3-year tiers (starting ~$168/month); pay-as-you-go available via Autodesk Flex.
Maya Indie: annual-only discounted subscription requiring <$100K USD annual creative revenue and no project valued over $100K; one license per user/org.
3ds Max subscription pricing page: annual (~$2,010/yr per Autodesk store), monthly, and 3-year tiers; Flex tokens for occasional use.
3ds Max Indie: annual-only indie tier with same <$100K revenue and <$100K project-value caps as Maya Indie; commercial use permitted.
Cinema 4D is subscription-licensed (monthly/annual via Maxon buy page); every subscription bundles Redshift GPU renderer and 5 Team Render nodes.
ZBrush desktop is subscription-only via ZBrush subscription or Maxon One; both include ZBrush for iPad (free iPad tier also offered).
Professional outlet reports ZBrush 2026 is rental-only at $49/month or $399/year including ZBrush for iPad; iPad-only $9.99/mo or $99.99/yr.
Houdini Indie ($299 1yr / $449 2yr) gives full FX feature set to artists making <$100K USD/year; max 3 Indie licenses per facility.
UE free until $1M lifetime gross revenue then 5% royalty (EGS sales royalty-free); >$1M-revenue non-game commercial use requires paid seat license.
Unity Personal free under $200K revenue/funding; Unity Pro from $2,310/yr or $210/mo per seat (required >$200K); Enterprise required >$25M.
Official Adobe compare-plans page for Substance 3D subscription tiers (Texturing vs Collection vs Teams/Enterprise).
Post-March-2025 prices: Texturing $24.99/mo ($249.88/yr), Collection $59.99/mo ($599.88/yr), Teams $1,439.88/yr; perpetual Painter/Designer $199.99.
MD licenses: Personal $39/month or $280 one-time 1-year prepaid; Student $99; Enterprise standalone $1,900/seat annual, network $2,000/seat.
